title: Creasura Agentic OS Protocol (CAOP) v0.2
description: JSON Schema definitions for CAOP v0.2 (current version). Builds on v0.1.2 (additive superset).

PrincipalRef.description: An authenticated principal: a person, a role, an agent, or a service account.

EntityRef.description: Identifier of any entity known to the OS, e.g. "property/14-oak-lane".

EvidenceRef.description: Identifier of a piece of evidence (an artifact, observation, or record) that supports a fact or outcome.

ArtifactRef.description: Identifier of a stored artifact such as a document or report.

Expression.description: A condition evaluated by the policy engine, e.g. "recipient.type == 'client'".

Criterion.description: A success criterion. "type" selects the evaluator; other members are evaluator-specific.

Constraint.description: A constraint on how a goal may be pursued.

AuthorizationPolicy.description: What a caller must hold to invoke a capability.

Goal.description: A desired outcome that persists beyond a single conversation.

WorkItem.description: A bounded unit of execution that advances a goal.

Fact.description: A durable, provenance-bearing statement in the OS state. Every material fact has a traceable source.

Capability.description: Something the OS can invoke to perform work.

enforcement.description: Advisory policies are instructions to a model. Enforced policies are checked by the runtime before an action executes.

Policy.description: A constraint governing execution. v0.1.2 adds minimum_attestation and pre_commit_hooks.

receipt_lease_seconds.description: Maximum duration a HOST_DELEGATED invocation may remain uncommitted in EXECUTE_DISPATCHED before transitioning to EXECUTE_EXPIRED.

required_receipt_fields.description: Provider-specific receipt verification keys that MUST be present in raw_output during VERIFY.

CapabilityDescriptor.description: What an execution provider can do, independent of any one AI vendor. v0.1.2 adds execution_locus, auth_custodian, receipt_lease_seconds, required_receipt_fields and promotion_policy.

CapabilityResult.description: The outcome of a capability invocation.

ExecutionState.description: Execution states. COMPLETED, CANCELLED, and EXPIRED are terminal. Invalid transitions are rejected.

ObservationCreate.description: Something the OS learned from an external source. Replaying the same source event must not create a duplicate.

ContextBundle.description: Resolved context. Retrieved facts and inferred interpretations are kept separate.

Commitment.description: A durable obligation. It cannot be marked completed solely because an agent claims it is complete.

Plan.description: A validated proposal. The runtime checks it against schemas, dependencies, and policy before execution.

ExecutionAccepted.description: Execution is asynchronous. Acceptance does not mean the work is complete.

Transition.description: Every accepted transition is persisted with an actor, timestamp, reason, and correlation ID.

Verification.description: A verdict must identify which checks were performed.

RecordCommit.description: A state mutation. A conflicting state version rejects the transaction or invokes a declared conflict policy.

Review.description: Recommendations are proposals, not authorized actions.

scope.description: What exactly is authorized, e.g. a document, amount, or recipient.

Approval.description: A scoped, expiring authorization for a consequential action.

event_type.description: e.g. observation.received, commitment.created, plan.approved, execution.started, execution.blocked, approval.requested, approval.granted, execution.completed, verification.failed, record.committed, goal.achieved

Error.description: Standard error envelope (§7.1). v0.1.2 adds CAOP_409_UNSETTLED_EXECUTION_LEASE (HTTP 409), CAOP_413_INVALIDATION_SUBGRAPH_TOO_LARGE (HTTP 413), CAOP_422_VERIFY_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH and the CAOP_422_PRECOMMIT_* codes (HTTP 422; CAOP_422_PRECOMMIT_HOOK_FAILED carries details.failed_hooks), and STAGE_UPGRADE_RECOMMENDED (advisory code, used in resume_brief.system_advisories).

MetricNode.description: A node in a hierarchical KPI tree. Variance beyond thresholds triggers Understand or a Commitment.

ApprovalRoutingRule.description: Delegation of Authority routing for a policy.

LoopDriver.description: Who drives the trigger loop: the conversational host (CLIENT_POLLED) or the Creasura kernel (KERNEL_MANAGED).

ExecutionLocus.description: Whether EXECUTE returns a delegation directive to the calling host or executes server-side.

AuthCustodian.description: Whether downstream OAuth tokens are held by the host client or stored in Creasura's vault.

AttestationTier.description: provenance.attestation: how the execution evidence behind a fact was obtained. Field presence is evidence, not proof; hence HOST_ASSERTED.

v0_1_conformance_level.description: CAOP-STAGE-1 and CAOP-STAGE-2 are variants of L2 (Stateful); CAOP-STAGE-3 corresponds to L3 (Autonomous).

ConformanceProfile.description: A runtime conformance profile. Advancing from Stage 1 to Stage 3 requires no breaking change to Goals, the eight-stage lifecycle, or bitemporal State queries.

PromotionPolicy.description: Threshold at which repeated EXECUTE_EXPIRED leases trigger a recommendation to promote a capability from HOST_DELEGATED (Stage 1) to KERNEL_PROXIED (Stage 2).

receipt_lease_seconds.description: Maximum duration a HOST_DELEGATED invocation may remain uncommitted in EXECUTE_DISPATCHED before transitioning to EXECUTE_EXPIRED.

required_receipt_fields.description: Provider-specific receipt verification keys that MUST be present in raw_output during VERIFY.

CapabilityRegistration.description: A capability as registered in the v0.1.2 Capability API. It MUST declare its execution locus, credential custodian, lease timeout, provider-specific receipt verification keys, and Stage-2 promotion thresholds.

EpistemicStatus.description: Adoption: CANDIDATE_PROPOSAL (UNDERSTAND or PLAN; excluded from default truth queries until ratified) → RATIFIED_COMMITMENT (passed pre-commit hooks and approval at COMMIT) → VERIFIED_FACT (promoted at RECORD once evidence passes VERIFY). Freshness is tracked separately.

Freshness.description: Freshness, separate from adoption. STALE_UPSTREAM_PREMISE is assigned by the kernel when a required premise has no remaining CURRENT support. A stale VERIFIED_FACT keeps epistemic_status VERIFIED_FACT. Default truth queries flag, but do not hide, stale entries.

DependsOnAlternatives.description: Groups of interchangeable supporting Fact IDs. Each inner array is one required premise; it stays supported while ANY member is CURRENT.

InvalidationContext.description: Why a dependent lost CURRENT support. Only freshness and invalidation_context change on dependents.

FactProvenance.description: Execution provenance of a fact. The attestation tier is immutable.

depends_on_fact_ids.description: Upstream Fact IDs; each entry is a required premise on its own.

BitemporalFact.description: A bitemporal fact (valid_time and transaction_time) with explicit upstream lineage and execution provenance. Superseded facts and their history are never rewritten.

max_invalidation_subgraph.description: Largest affected subgraph one update may invalidate. Larger updates are rejected before commit with CAOP_413_INVALIDATION_SUBGRAPH_TOO_LARGE; nothing is partially applied.

StateConfig.description: Workspace State API limits for synchronous causal invalidation.

target_path.description: Path into the staged work, e.g. commitment.owner_principal_id

condition.description: e.g. NON_EMPTY_PRINCIPAL_REF, NON_EMPTY_ARRAY, ALL_UPSTREAM_FACTS_VERIFIED_ACTIVE (every upstream fact is VERIFIED_FACT with freshness CURRENT)

error_code.description: A CAOP_422_PRECOMMIT_* code reported in failed_hooks

PreCommitHook.description: A deterministic check evaluated at COMMIT before a plan may reach EXECUTE_PENDING or request approval.

PolicyRegistration.description: A Policy as registered in the v0.1.2 Policy API.

ExecuteSubState.description: Sub-states of the EXECUTE lifecycle stage. They refine, not replace, the v0.1 execution states: EXECUTE_PENDING ↔ READY; EXECUTE_DISPATCHED ↔ RUNNING (host-delegated); EXECUTE_COMPLETED → VERIFYING; EXECUTE_EXPIRED ↔ EXPIRED; EXECUTE_FAILED ↔ FAILED.

CommitSubState.description: Sub-state of the COMMIT lifecycle stage: pre-commit hooks passed, human approval required before dispatch. Maps to WAITING_APPROVAL / POLICY_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

DispatchStep.description: One mandatory step the host must perform in the same turn.

DispatchDirective.description: Normative Stage-1 dispatch response (anti-termination envelope). turn_directive and DO_NOT_RESPOND_TO_USER_YET are instructions to the host model; the enforceable guarantee is the lease lock (CAOP_409_UNSETTLED_EXECUTION_LEASE).

GoalPulseSLA.description: Heartbeat SLA for a CLIENT_POLLED Goal (the dead-man’s switch). Requires a kernel-side timer and an out-of-band notification channel.

hydrate_capability_ids.description: Lazy Capability Discovery: Pass specific capability IDs from the stub directory to load their full JSON input schemas.

PulseInput.description: v0.2 adds compaction_mode and hydrate_capability_ids (published inputSchema: PulseInputV02).

supersedes_work_id.description: Optional ID of a STALE_UPSTREAM_PREMISE work item being replaced.

depends_on_fact_ids.description: Upstream Fact IDs that this derived fact or decision relies upon. Omit if unknown; the REQUIRE_EVIDENCE_LINEAGE hook will reject commit and the host must ask the user.

depends_on_alternatives.description: Optional groups of interchangeable supporting Fact IDs. The premise stays supported while any member is CURRENT.

owner_principal_id.description: Explicit human or agent principal responsible for this commitment. Omit if unknown; the REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_OWNER hook will reject commit and the host must ask the user.

parent_work_id.description: Stages this work as a child work scope of the given parent (hierarchical sub-agent isolation).

StageWorkInput.description: v0.2 adds parent_work_id and isolation_policy for child work scopes.

DispatchWorkInput.description: v0.2 adds APPROVE_WITH_STEERING_DELTA, steering_delta and two_phase_verification (published inputSchema: DispatchWorkInputV02).

raw_output.description: Raw JSON output from the host native tool containing all required_receipt_fields.

SettleReceiptInput.description: v0.2 adds distilled_return_payload, returned by a child work scope when it completes RECORD.

OpenLease.description: An unsettled EXECUTE_DISPATCHED or EXECUTE_EXPIRED invocation.

StaleCommitment.description: A commitment whose freshness is STALE_UPSTREAM_PREMISE; it keeps its adoption status.

ResumeBrief.description: Deterministic, ranked delta brief returned at the start of a session, without file uploads or chat history reconstruction.

PulseResponse.description: Normative caop_pulse response payload. v0.2 adds capability_stubs, hydrated_capabilities and outcome_verifications.

StageWorkResult.description: UNDERSTAND → COMMIT → PLAN: pre-commit hooks passed; halted at approval (COMMIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL) or at EXECUTE_PENDING.

SettlementResult.description: Result of VERIFY → RECORD (→ REVIEW): receipt verified, facts recorded with their attestation tier, thread lease released. v0.2: with a phase_2_deferred check, settlement records the receipt and returns sub_state RECORDED_AWAITING_OUTCOME_VERIFY.

DispatchWorkResult.description: HOST_DELEGATED: the anti-termination DispatchDirective. KERNEL_PROXIED: executed via the vault with VERIFY + RECORD auto-folded, returning a SettlementResult.

SteeringDelta.description: Non-destructive mid-flight overrides applied before EXECUTE without aborting the work lifecycle.

VerifySubState.description: Sub-states of the VERIFY lifecycle stage. VERIFY_PHASE_1_IMMEDIATE validates the execution receipt (nonce and artifact); VERIFY_PHASE_2_DEFERRED evaluates success_predicate with verification_capability_id once check_after_seconds has elapsed. Both map to the v0.1 VERIFYING state.

RecordSubState.description: Receipts recorded in Phase 1 are written as facts with their attestation tier, and the commitment stays open until the deferred Phase-2 check passes. Maps to the v0.1 VERIFYING state: the execution reaches COMPLETED only after that check passes. In CAOP-STAGE-1 the check runs on the next caop_pulse after check_after_seconds, so it depends on the host pulsing.

OutcomeVerification.description: A deferred Phase-2 outcome check as reported by caop_pulse.

max_token_budget.description: Enforced by the kernel only when it drives the model (CAOP-STAGE-3); advisory in CAOP-STAGE-1.

trace_hash.description: Content hash of the pruned raw trace, e.g. "sha256:<hex>". Promoted facts keep it as part of their provenance pointer.

retention_policy.description: Declared retention policy under which raw traces MAY be deleted, e.g. "retain_30_days". Without one, pruned traces leave the active context but are not deleted.

IsolationPolicy.description: How a child work scope is isolated from its parent. A child inherits the parent’s authority and can only narrow it.

trace_hash.description: Content hash of the pruned raw trace, e.g. "sha256:<hex>". Promoted facts keep it as part of their provenance pointer.

retention_policy.description: Declared retention policy under which raw traces MAY be deleted, e.g. "retain_30_days". Without one, pruned traces leave the active context but are not deleted.

DistilledReturnPayload.description: What a child work scope returns to its parent at RECORD: the ratified commitment and distilled facts only. Pruning removes raw traces from the active context, not from provenance: every promoted fact keeps a provenance pointer (child work_id, invocation IDs and trace_hash).

ChildWork.description: A child work scope (hierarchical sub-agent isolation), as staged through caop_stage_work.

CapabilityStub.description: Compact directory entry returned by caop_pulse. Capabilities are not MCP tools: they are invoked through caop_stage_work plan_steps by capability_id.

HydratedCapability.description: A capability schema hydrated on request (hydrate_capability_ids). It is returned as data; it does not change the host’s tool list.

steering_delta.description: Non-destructive mid-flight overrides applied before EXECUTE without aborting the work lifecycle.

hydrate_capability_ids.description: Lazy Capability Discovery: Pass specific capability IDs from the stub directory to load their full JSON input schemas.
